items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: There was five piano players, you remember? Five piano players. Willie “The Lion”, Earl Hines, Marian McPartland, and Hank Jones. And the drummer was Louie Bellson. Jim Hall was the guitar player—

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, friends of Ellington. Yeah.
There was five piano players, you remember? Five piano players. Willie “The Lion”, Earl Hines, Marian McPartland, and Hank Jones. And the drummer was Louie Bellson. Jim Hall was the guitar player—
And Dizzy Gillespie was just in the audience.
